millionParameterGate.rule: 192 labels; plain/composed and four origins weighted equally; 100k improves pooled validation MSE by >=10% over 526, improves in >=2/3 source worlds, and all 100k primary fits finite with exact unrelated-branch preservation.
millionParameterGate.note: Gate通過は自律的人格の良さやNNの一般的優位の証明ではない。追加試験は調整者が別途固定する。
